integrity: Complete conventional proof and standalone finite verifier supplied. Finite computation is explicitly not substituted for infinite proof. This finding has no independent external validation.
scientific_limitations: The new claim concerns real zero geometry of connected domination polynomials of crowns for n>=3, not the previously available enumerator. Complex nonreal zeros are not localized and no global complex limiting measure is determined. Priority assessment remains conditional on accessible literature.
title: Exactly two nonzero real connected-domination roots for crown graphs, with parity-dependent logarithmic convergence
